I am a 49-year-old woman with no schooling in Mulanje, and this small 0.11 ha sorghum plot is just one piece of my 2.97 ha farm. Sorghum is a hardy crop that grows well here with the rains, and because it is intercropped and not maize, I do not receive any FISP coupons for it. I cannot afford to buy fertilizer from the market for this plot when my family needs that money for food and school expenses, so I will rely on our own strength and local seed as we have always done.
